races.name: Darley EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
JCB Newmarket Stakes (Listed Race) (Colts & Geldings)

runners_data.name: Lyneham
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after 209-day break under in-form David Egan, but his class suggests he can handle the layoff.

runners_data.name: My Love Is King
runners_data.note: Natural leader in good recent form who should handle the ground conditions based on his Goodwood success.

runners_data.name: Poseidon's Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with headgear applied who needs a strong gallop to be seen at his best under Appleby's guidance.

runners_data.name: Ancient Egypt
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent racer returning from a long absence but has proven course form and handles these conditions well.

runners_data.name: Archers Bay
runners_data.note: Front-runner wearing a pacifier who showed improved form last time and could appreciate the step up in trip.

races.paceDynamic: My Love Is King and Archers Bay will clash for the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to ensure a genuine gallop from the start. Lyneham and Ancient Egypt should settle prominently behind the leaders, while Poseidon's Warrior will be held up at the rear looking for cover. The honest pace created by the dual-speed battle upfront should play to the strengths of horses that can travel well in behind and finish strongly. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up performer and prominent racers who can quicken late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If My Love Is King and Archers Bay go head-to-head from the start
scenarios.body: The genuine early pace will suit Poseidon's Warrior perfectly as he gets the strong gallop his hold-up style demands. Lyneham can also benefit from the honest tempo by tracking the leaders before delivering his challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If My Love Is King or Archers Bay gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more sedate without the early battle, allowing the front-runner to control the race and potentially stay on for victory. Prominent racers like Ancient Egypt could also benefit from the steady tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Waiting Game
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders show early restraint and settle behind each other
scenarios.body: The pace becomes falsely-run which would compromise Poseidon's Warrior's chances and favour horses with natural speed. Lyneham's prominent style becomes more effective when he can use his turn of foot in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If neither leader wants to make the running early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling affair that turns into a sprint from the home turn. This plays directly into the hands of horses with natural gate speed who can position prominently without effort.

watchPoints.text: Poseidon's Warrior needs a genuine early pace - if both leaders compromise each other's speed he could be stranded too far back
Lyneham faces fitness concerns after his 209-day absence and may need this run despite his obvious class advantage
My Love Is King has shown improved form recently and could dictate terms if he gets first run on Archers Bay
Ancient Egypt returns from a long break but has strong course form and could outrun his odds if fit enough
Archers Bay wears a pacifier suggesting temperament issues that could surface in a small field where tactics matter

races.name: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" Handicap

runners_data.name: Objector
runners_data.note: Front-runner with back-to-back wins but 98 days off could see fitness questioned despite his early pace style

runners_data.name: Fort Rock
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for in-form Appleby stable but 177-day absence is a major concern despite his winning last two starts

runners_data.name: Zennor Storm
runners_data.note: Natural leader with winning form but the 149-day break and Haggas' modest recent strike-rate are negatives

runners_data.name: St Anton
runners_data.note: Prominent tracker with best recent RPR of 100 and only 17 days since last run, well-handicapped on 127lbs

runners_data.name: Vincenzo Peruggia
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner whose recent second came in soft ground, better suited by today's good conditions

runners_data.name: Comic Hero
runners_data.note: Prominent racer carrying just 123lbs with Murphy aboard, recent fifth was disappointing but yard in decent form

runners_data.name: Elan d'Or
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 149-day break with back-to-back wins last season but question marks over current form

runners_data.name: Lake Como
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent form including two wins, perfectly positioned tactically if pace is genuine

runners_data.name: Royal Bodyguard
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner carrying minimum weight after 225-day break, fresh legs could be crucial in strong-run race

races.paceDynamic: Objector, Vincenzo Peruggia, and Zennor Storm will set a genuine gallop from the off, with all three having confirmed front-running styles and recent winning form. Fort Rock, St Anton, Comic Hero, and Elan d'Or will create severe congestion in the prominent positions, leading to tactical complications and potential traffic issues approaching the home turn. The strong early pace will stretch the field and test stamina credentials over this stiff Newmarket mile. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up horses Lake Como and Royal Bodyguard, who can avoid the early scrimmaging and benefit from the guaranteed strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders maintain a strong gallop and the prominent pack gets shuffled
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will set up perfectly for Lake Como and Royal Bodyguard to come from behind with their superior finishing kicks. The early traffic problems among the prominent runners will eliminate several dangers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early leader stays on
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front three gets first run and the pace is merely honest rather than fierce
scenarios.body: Objector or Vincenzo Peruggia could steal a march turning for home before the closers can organise their challenge. Their recent winning form suggests they have the class to sustain their effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the prominent horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: Fort Rock or St Anton could exploit their handy positions to strike in the final furlong when the leaders tire. The Appleby and Hannon yards know how to place their horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so fierce that it eliminates all the fancied runners
scenarios.body: Royal Bodyguard's 7lb weight advantage and fresh condition after 225 days off could see him pick up the pieces. Comic Hero also carries a light weight and has Oisin Murphy aboard.

watchPoints.text: Objector and Vincenzo Peruggia could burn each other out in a speed duel, setting up the race for closers
Fort Rock and Zennor Storm both return from long breaks which could undermine their chances despite previous winning form
St Anton carries 11lbs more than Royal Bodyguard which could prove decisive if the pace collapses
Lake Como's hold-up style perfectly suits this pace scenario but needs the leaders to go fast enough
Comic Hero's light weight of 123lbs makes him dangerous if Murphy can secure a smooth passage from his prominent position

races.name: Betfred Jockey Club Stakes (Group 2)

runners_data.name: Lion's Pride
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist from the in-form Gosden yard, should relish the likely strong pace and has a good recent Newmarket record

runners_data.name: Sunway
runners_data.note: Back down in trip after running well in longer contests, Menuisier's only runner suggests confidence in the distance switch

runners_data.name: Bay City Roller
runners_data.note: Returning from 174-day break but Scott's 23% strike-rate with absentees and last-time-out Ascot winner suggests readiness

runners_data.name: Paradias
runners_data.note: King's jumps background shows in patient tactics, has been running well in similar company and trip suits perfectly

runners_data.name: French Master
runners_data.note: Long absence of 251 days is a concern despite Gosden's 19% record with returning horses, needs to prove fitness

runners_data.name: Santorini Star
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong course record, 3lb claimer Marquand adds tactical flexibility for Haggas

runners_data.name: Eydon
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with solid recent Newmarket form, Murphy's 12% strike-rate for Balding suggests confidence in chances

races.paceDynamic: Eydon and Santorini Star will dictate early fractions, with Eydon the more natural leader but neither inclined to force a blistering gallop over this staying trip. The small field and lack of genuine speed merchants means a measured tempo through the first mile, setting up a stamina test from the 3f pole. This tactical affair will become a test of class and finishing kick in the final quarter-mile. The sustainable pace and strong finish clearly favours the hold-up horses who can produce late acceleration.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains modest as expected and the race develops into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up brigade prove optimal as they sweep past the early leaders in the final 2f. Class and finishing speed become the decisive factors rather than tactical position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Santorini Star and Eydon maintain their forward positions and kick clear 3f out
scenarios.body: The race develops into a staying test where the horses who travelled in striking distance can sustain their effort. Those held up too far back struggle to make up the ground on the straight Newmarket track.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway as jockeys jostle for position
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates gaps for the most tactically astute partnerships. Murphy and Marquand's experience becomes crucial in navigating the unfolding battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If both early leaders Eydon and Santorini Star come back dramatically in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of who can quickest into top gear from unpromising positions. The freshest and most talented closer capitalizes on the pace meltdown.

watchPoints.text: Bay City Roller's market support despite 174-day absence could signal stable confidence in his wellbeing
French Master's betting movements given the 251-day layoff and whether punters believe he's ready first time back
Early positioning of Santorini Star and whether Marquand opts for his usual prominent tactics or sits quieter
Eydon's early fractions and if Murphy allows him to dictate or restrains him for a later challenge
Lion's Pride's market position given the Gosden stable's excellent current form and his strong Newmarket record

races.name: Betfred "Nifty 50" Handicap

runners_data.name: Elarak
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong 7f form but poor recent record on good going (0 from 6) is a concern despite class advantage

runners_data.name: Billyjoh
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 203-day break with useful headgear, but trainer struggling for winners recently

runners_data.name: Shah
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut after three excellent placed efforts, significant unknown quantity

runners_data.name: Leadman
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in decent current form but long winless streak and 3lb claimer suggests connections lack confidence

runners_data.name: Silver Ghost
runners_data.note: Patient ride specialist returning from long break with strong 7f record, but inconsistent recent efforts worry

runners_data.name: Misunderstood
runners_data.note: Natural leader who will control the pace but awful recent record on good going makes him vulnerable late

runners_data.name: Benacre
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good current form and racing off career-low mark after recent encouraging third

runners_data.name: Golden Redemption
runners_data.note: Tactical runner with strong recent form and excellent 7f record, well-handicapped on best efforts

races.paceDynamic: Misunderstood will take them along as the only confirmed leader, with Golden Redemption, Benacre and Elarak sitting handy behind in the early stages. With just one front runner, Misunderstood can dictate a steady tempo without pressure, allowing the field to bunch up approaching the final 2f. The lack of pace pressure early means this becomes a sprint from the 2f pole, heavily favouring those with tactical speed and strong finishing kicks. This race shape strongly benefits hold-up horses and those with proven finishing speed over genuine pace-setters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Misunderstood sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches approaching 2f out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the back with those saving ground having most left in the tank. Billyjoh, Shah and Silver Ghost can unleash finishing kicks from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Redemption or Elarak can sit close enough to the pace while keeping something in reserve
scenarios.body: The class horses with tactical speed can pounce when Misunderstood weakens, having stalked the modest gallop perfectly. Their superior ratings tell when the sprint develops.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Misunderstood gets very soft fractions and the field fails to organize a proper challenge
scenarios.body: The front runner maintains enough energy to resist late challengers on this stiff track finish. His lack of recent good form on similar going becomes irrelevant with perfect tactical conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse Creates Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Misunderstood goes too slow early and multiple horses move up simultaneously at the 3f pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes scrappy with no clear pace advantage, turning into a muddling affair where stamina trumps speed. The longest-priced runners can capitalize on the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Misunderstood sets the fractions as lone leader - if he goes too slow early, this becomes a sitting duck scenario
Golden Redemption and Elarak getting prominent positions - their class advantage becomes decisive in a truly-run race
Shah making handicap debut from attractive mark - any market support suggests strong stable confidence
Billyjoh's return from 203-day absence with headgear - fitness levels crucial for his finishing kick
Track conditions remaining genuinely good - any deterioration would significantly impact several runners' chances

races.name: Pertemps Network King Charles II Stakes (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: Saber Strike
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with strong form but 178-day layoff creates fitness question despite Haggas/Marquand combination.

runners_data.name: Cerro Blanco
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs pace to aim at, benefits from Appleby's strong recent form and quick return from last win.

runners_data.name: Jel Pepper
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with solid recent form, though trainer's poor recent strike rate is concerning.

runners_data.name: Maximized
runners_data.note: Another Appleby runner who races prominently, strong recent form suggests stable confidence despite moderate ratings.

runners_data.name: Stellar Sunrise
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with excellent recent form, Murphy booking significant positive for controlling tactics.

runners_data.name: Ellusive Butterfly
runners_data.note: Prominent racer carrying weight penalty, Burke stable in good form but needs everything to fall right.

races.paceDynamic: Stellar Sunrise will likely lead from the gates with most others content to race prominently behind. With only six runners and no confirmed second front-runner, Stellar Sunrise can dictate terms without pressure through steady fractions. The lack of genuine hold-up horses means the pace will be honest but not fierce, with Jel Pepper, Maximized, and Saber Strike tracking closely. This controlled tempo strongly favours the pace-setter and prominent racers who can position handily early, as there's insufficient closing speed in the field to mount effective late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Stellar Sunrise Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Stellar Sunrise gets uncontested lead and steady fractions
scenarios.body: Murphy can dictate ideal splits from the front while others jostle for position behind. The lack of genuine closers means those tracking the leader are best placed to strike in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Stellar Sunrise sets reasonable pace but fades late
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with prominent runners ideally placed to pounce when leader weakens. Form horses with tactical speed gain the advantage in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improved Hold-Up Performance
scenarios.trigger: If genuine pace pressure emerges and creates strong gallop
scenarios.body: Cerro Blanco benefits from faster tempo that sets up his closing kick. The Appleby stable form and recent win provide confidence for step up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Messy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If overly cautious early pace leads to sprint from halfway
scenarios.body: All horses remain in contention longer creating cavalry charge finish. Class and recent form become decisive factors in bunched conclusion.

watchPoints.text: Stellar Sunrise breaking slowly or facing early pressure would completely alter race dynamics and eliminate main advantage.
Jel Pepper and Saber Strike both need to secure good early positions to utilise their prominent racing styles effectively.
Cerro Blanco requires genuine pace pressure early to set up closing kick from customary hold-up position.
Maximized's consistency suggests place claims but needs Stellar Sunrise to come back to field late.
Weather conditions remaining stable as any track deterioration would impact prominent racers' effectiveness.

races.name: Close Brothers Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Cuban Lady

runners_data.name: Orchid

runners_data.name: Mercury Day

runners_data.name: Angel Love

runners_data.name: Powdering

runners_data.name: Cinque Verde

runners_data.name: Lady Roxby

runners_data.name: Paradise Walk
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent 3-year-old wearing blinkers, Ralph Beckett having decent spell with 4 winners from 21 runners in last fortnight

runners_data.name: Lightning Polka
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning from 178-day absence, Ed Walker's yard in good form but long break concerning despite previous course winner

runners_data.name: Lady Kodiac
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has lost her way recently, James Tate 0 from 13 in last 14 days and mare's RPR suggests she's regressed

runners_data.name: Fantasy Obsessor

races.paceDynamic: Cinque Verde is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the rail, likely getting an uncontested lead with soft fractions. The prominent group of Cuban Lady, Mercury Day, Angel Love, Paradise Walk, Lady Kodiac, Slay Queen and Fantasy Obsessor will track behind but none are aggressive enough pace pressers to force the issue early. The hold-up brigade of Orchid, Powdering, Lady Roxby, Lightning Polka and Anaisa will be relying on a strong finish but may find themselves with too much ground to make up if the pace stays moderate. This race shape clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early without having to make devastating late moves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cinque Verde Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Cinque Verde gets the soft lead anticipated and isn't headed turning for home
scenarios.body: The lone leader dictates every call and has enough in reserve to repel late challengers on ground that's riding fair. The hold-up horses find the gaps too late and the pace too controlled to mount effective rallies.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners successfully stalks Cinque Verde and outkicks in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The early pace remains sensible but a well-positioned tracker gets first run on the leader and sustains the effort better than the hold-up horses stuck in traffic. Those racing handy prove superior to those coming from the back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or the field comes back to the closers in the final 100 yards
scenarios.body: A truly run race or tactical error from the front allows the strongest finishers to sweep past tired leaders. The hold-up horses finally get the race shape they need with plenty of pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Wide Open
scenarios.trigger: If pace pressure emerges unexpectedly or interference/traffic creates a muddled affair
scenarios.body: Multiple prominent horses pressure each other early creating a stop-start rhythm that suits neither leaders nor hold-up horses consistently. An opportunist from any style group can capitalize on the tactical confusion.

watchPoints.text: Cinque Verde's jumping from the stalls - if she misses the break badly, the entire pace scenario collapses and favors the hold-up horses dramatically
The gap that develops between Cinque Verde and the first tracker - if it's more than 3-4 lengths, the leader may have too much in hand
Cuban Lady's fitness levels after 192 days off - early signs of distress would suggest the layoff has left its mark despite Murphy's booking
Lady Roxby and Lightning Polka getting clear runs in the final furlong - both need luck in running to be effective from hold-up positions
Paradise Walk's blinkers impact on her racing style - any change from her usual prominent position could signal equipment isn't working
